recommended_policy.public_default: require user template + cohort check; do not silently install an institutional default
recommended_policy.source_priority: Applicable binding/cohort rules, then user's applicable designated template text/comments, then general school requirements, then implementation defaults. Sample OOXML and published thesis appearance are evidence, not normative rules.
recommended_policy.pdf_comment_balloon_caveat: Legacy PDF renders review balloons and shrinks content to fit them. Do not infer final clean layout dimensions from PDF screenshot geometry.
recommended_policy.conversion_caveat: macOS textutil converts old DOC to text for comment extraction but its DOCX conversion loses comment structure and yields Letter page settings; converted DOCX is not a faithful format master. For real formatting use a layout-preserving converter on a copy, then verify against original comments.
recommended_policy.user_clarification_2026_11_01: MEM论文以学院最新模板为准；本项目当前学院2026 MEM，旧样板仅历史对照，不作为现行MEM正式选项。
